gate.title: Before generating your sermon
gate.intro: Here's what we tracked of your work on this passage. Not a score: it's the actual coverage of your study.
gate.weakDimsTitle: Some dimensions are not yet covered
gate.weakDimsHint: I recommend going deeper before preaching. Concrete starting points:

promptFor.D1_lectura: Did you re-read the full passage and record your first impression?
promptFor.D2_contextoGenero: Confirm the literary genre and write how it changes your reading rules.
promptFor.D3_estructura: Identify the climactic clause and how the rest of the passage supports it.
promptFor.D4_palabras: Add at least 2 key-word studies with your own discovery.
promptFor.D5_reconocimiento: Find 1-3 canonical parallels with clear theological weight (no proof-texting).
promptFor.D6_funcion: Articulate what the text did to its original audience before applying it today.
promptFor.D7_confrontacion: Consider at least one significant contrary position and dismantle it from the text.

gate.justificationLabel: Explain why you consider this study sufficient or why you want to proceed with partial coverage
gate.justificationPlaceholder: E.g. I already covered the parallels in a prior series on this book; accumulated depth supports this sermon…
